# Load the data

print(refunded_converted_one[['order_id', 'status', 'converted', 'revenue']].head())

# Also check: are there any completed orders with converted == 0?
completed = data[data['status'] == 'completed']
completed_converted_zero = completed[completed['converted'] == 0]
